Project Overview
This project is a Ruby on Rails Helpdesk API that uses PostgreSQL for data persistence and Redis for supporting backend services. It focuses on reliable API development, secure data access, and automated code quality and security checks.

Pull Request Checklist
  - [ ] Tests added or updated, CI green
  - [ ] Cross-tenant and cross-user access specs where data is read or written
  - [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, logs or fixtures
  - [ ] Migration reviewed for locking and for all tenant schemas
  - [ ] Endpoint documented
